d: Sunreef Yachts is looking for a proactive, well-organized and detail-oriented Paralegal / Legal Assistant to support its legal, administrative and operational activities in the United Arab Emirates.

The successful candidate will work closely with the company's legal function, management and various departments, providing day-to-day assistance with contracts, corporate documentation, internal requests, compliance-related matters and project coordination.
This is a cross-functional role requiring strong organizational skills, a hands-on approach and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic international business environment.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field.
Previous experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, contract administration or similar role is preferred.
Experience in the UAE business environment is an advantage.
Good understanding of contractual documentation and corporate administrative processes.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to prioritize competing tasks.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
Ability to work independently, follow up proactively and communicate effectively across departments.
Professionalism, discretion and a high level of confidentiality.
r: Assist in drafting, reviewing, formatting and organizing commercial agreements, NDAs, supplier contracts, service agreements and other legal documents.
Prepare contract templates, amendments, correspondence, internal approvals and supporting documentation.
Maintain and update contract registers, legal records, corporate documents and filing systems.
Monitor contractual deadlines, renewals, signatures and outstanding documentation.
Coordinate document execution and follow up with internal and external stakeholders.
Support the legal team in liaising with external legal advisors, authorities and business partners.
Act as a point of contact for routine legal and documentation-related requests from internal departments.
Support HR with employment-related documentation, internal policies, agreements and administrative legal matters.
Assist Finance with contractual documentation, payment-related correspondence, supplier documentation and supporting records.
Work with Production and Procurement teams on supplier agreements, purchase-related documentation, project contracts and operational requests.
Support Marketing and Sales with NDAs, cooperation agreements, event-related documentation and other contractual requirements.
Coordinate with relevant departments to collect information, prepare documents and ensure timely completion of requests.
Assist with corporate documentation, licensing, renewals and compliance-related administrative processes.
Prepare letters, resolutions, authorizations, reports, presentations and internal documentation.
Support ongoing business and operational projects by tracking tasks, deadlines, deliverables and required approvals.
Coordinate meetings, follow-ups and communication between departments and external parties.
Assist management and the legal team with ad hoc assignments and special projects.
